output.answer:
**There is no 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 — Skechers no longer files periodic reports with the SEC.**

Skechers U.S.A., Inc. was acquired by 3G Capital in a $9 billion take-private deal. The merger closed on **September 12, 2025**, the stock was delisted from the NYSE (ticker SKX) the same day, and the company filed an 8-K confirming it requested Form 25 deregistration. Its own merger materials stated that after closing, "Skechers will no longer file periodic reports, current reports, proxy or information statements with the SEC." So the June 30, 2026 quarter has no public 10-Q, and no Q2 2026 figures are available in USD millions from a filing.

**Latest available 10-Q: quarter ended June 30, 2025** (filed Aug. 8, 2025, the last quarterly report before the deal closed):

| ($ in millions) | Q2 2025 | Q2 2024 |
|---|---|---|
| Sales | $2,440.0 | $2,157.6 |
| Earnings from operations | $173.1 | $206.5 |
| Net earnings attributable to Skechers | $170.5 | $140.3 |

Note the operating-line divergence: sales rose 13.1% while earnings from operations fell 16.2%, driven by a jump in G&A expenses (tariff-related costs, shipping/packaging).

Sources:
- Skechers Q2 2025 10-Q (SEC): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1065837/000095017025105871/skx-20250630.htm
- Q2 2025 earnings release: https://about.skechers.com/press-release/skechers-announces-second-quarter-2025-financial-results
- 3G Capital completion / NYSE delisting: https://about.skechers.com/press-release/3g-capital-completes-acquisition-of-skechers
- 8-K on deregistration: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1065837/000119312525201846/d41926d8k.htm
